T>\nT kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {\n    T sum = 0.0;\n    T c = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        T y = val - c;\n        T t = sum + y;\n        c = (t - sum) - y;\n        sum = t;\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// Print results for floating-point arrays\ntemplate <typename T>\nvoid print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = \"Result\") {\n    if  }\n\n    const size_t N = data.size();\n    \n    // Compute statistics\n    T sum = kahan_sum(data);\n    T min_val = data[0];\n    T max_val = data[0];\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);\n        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);\n    }\n    \n    // Compute hash\n    hash h;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        h.add(val);\n    }\n    \n %zu\\n\", N);\n    printf(\"Sum: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(sum));\n    printf(\"Min: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(min_val));\n    printf(\"Max: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(max_val));\n    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {\n        printf(\"Sample[%zu]: %.17e\\n\", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));\n    }\n    printf(\"Hash: %016\" PRIx64 \"\\n\", h.get());\n    printf(\"=== END RESULTS ===\\n\");\n}\n\n// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)\ntemplate <typename T>\nvoid print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = \"Result\") {\n    if (data.empty()) {\n        printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n        printf(\"Name: %s\\n\", name);\n        printf(\"Elements: 0\\n\");\n        printf(\"=== END RESULTS Each rank drives one GPU.\n// Step k: the owner of block row k factors the diagonal block (and inverts it),\n// broadcasts L_kk^{-1}; every rank solves its part of panel column k, the panel is\n// all-gathered and every rank applies the symmetric trailing update to its rows.\n// A depth-1 lookahead overlaps panel factorization + communication with the\n// trailing update on a second CUDA stream.\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                              \\\n    do {                                                                              \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                    \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                    \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_),     \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                              \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                             \\\n        }                                                                             \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstatic constexpr int NB = 128;                 // block size (multiple of GEMM tile)\nstatic constexpr int TRI = NB * (NB + 1) / 2;  // packed lower triangle size\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// GPU kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// C[M x N] = beta * C + alpha * A[M x K] * B[N x K]^T  (all row-major)\n// M, N multiples of 64, K multiple of 16.\n// If LOWER, tiles lying strictly above the global diagonal are skipped. C's local\n// row r belongs to local block row (lb0 + r / NB) whose global block index is\n// (lb0 + r / NB) * nprocs + rank; C's column c is global column colBase + c.\nstatic constexpr int TM = 64, TN = 64, TK = 16;\n\ntemplate <bool LOWER>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(256) gemm_nt_kernel(int K, const double* __restrict__ A, size_t lda,\n                                                      const double* __restrict__ B, size_t ldb,\n                                                      double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc, double alpha,\n                                                      double beta, int lb0, int nprocs, int rank,\n                                                      int colBase) {\n    const int m0 = blockIdx.y * TM;\n    const int n0 = blockIdx.x * TN;\n    if (LOWER) {\n        const int lb = lb0 + m0 / NB;\n        const long gRowMax = (long)(lb * nprocs + rank) * NB + (m0 % NB) + TM - 1;\n        if ((long)colBase + n0 > gRowMax) return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double As[2][TK][TM + 1];\n    __shared__ double Bs[2][TK][TN + 1];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int tx = tid & 15, ty = tid >> 4;\n\n    const double* Ab = A + (size_t)m0 * lda;\n    const double* Bb = B + (size_t)n0 * ldb;\n\n    double ra[4], rb[4];\n    auto loadGlobal = [&](int k0) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int l = 0; l < 4; ++l) {\n            const int idx = tid + 256 * l;\n            const int r = idx >> 4, kk = idx & 15;\n            ra[l] = Ab[(size_t)r * lda + k0 + kk];\n            rb[l] = Bb[(size_t)r * ldb + k0 + kk];\n        }\n    };\n    auto storeShared = [&](int buf) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int l = 0; l < 4; ++l) {\n            const int idx = tid + 256 * l;\n            const int r = idx >> 4, kk = idx & 15;\n            As[buf][kk][r] = ra[l];\n            Bs[buf][kk][r] = rb[l];\n        }\n    };\n\n    double acc[4][4];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] = 0.0;\n\n    loadGlobal(0);\n    storeShared(0);\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int buf = 0;\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += TK) {\n        const bool more = (k0 + TK) < K;\n        if (more) loadGlobal(k0 + TK);\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; i < 4; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] = fma(a[i], b[j], acc[i][j]);\n        }\n        if (more) {\n            storeShared(buf ^ 1);\n            __syncthreads();\n            buf ^= 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {\n        double* crow = C + (size_t)(m0 + ty + 16 * i) * ldc + n0;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {\n            const int c = tx + 16 * j;\n            if (beta == 0.0)\n                crow[c] = alpha * acc[i][j];\n            else\n                crow[c] = beta * crow[c] + alpha * acc[i][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Factor one NB x NB diagonal block in place (lower part), write L^{-1} (full\n// NB x NB, zero upper) to Linv. info = global index of first non-positive pivot.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(1024) potrf_inv_kernel(double* __restrict__ D, size_t ldd,\n                                                         double* __restrict__ Linv, int* info,\n                                                         long gBase) {\n    extern __shared__ double S[]; j < NB; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double val = S[j * (j + 1) / 2 + j];\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                failed = 1;\n                *info = (int)(gBase + j);\n            } else {\n                S[j * (j + 1) / 2 + j] = sqrt(val);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (failed) return;\n        const double djj = S[j * (j + 1) / 2 + j];\n        for (int i = j + 1 + tid; S[i * (i + 1) / 2 + c] : 0.0;\n        if (c > i) Linv[(size_t)i * NB + c] = 0.0;\n    }\n\n    // Triangular inverse: column j of X = L^{-1} solved by one warp, x kept in registers\n    const int lane = tx, warp = ty;\n    for (int j = warp; j < NB; j += 32) {\n        double xr[NB / 32];\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int t = 0; t < NB / 32; ++t) xr[t] = 0.0;\n        for (int i = j; i < NB; ++i) {\n            const int rowOff = i * (i + 1) / 2;\n            double s = 0.0;\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int t = 0; t < NB / 32; ++t) {\n                const int m = lane + 32 * t;\n                if (m >= j && m < i) s = fma(S[rowOff + m], xr[t], s);\n            }\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffffu, s, o);\n            const double x = ((i == j ? 1.0 : 0.0) - s) / S[rowOff + i];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int t = 0; t < NB / 32; ++t)\n                if (lane + 32 * t == i) xr[t] = x;\n            if (lane == 0) Linv[(size_t)i * NB + j] = x;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Zero the strictly upper triangle (global coordinates) of local block rows.\n__global__ void zero_upper_kernel(double* A, size_t lda, int nrows, int ncols, int nprocs, int rank) {\n    const int r = blockIdx.y;\n    if (r >= nrows) return;\n    const long g = (long)((r / NB) * nprocs + rank) * NB + r % NB;\n    double* row = A + (size_t)r * lda;\n    for (long c = g + 1 + blockIdx.x * (long)blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; c < ncols;\n         c += (long)gridDim.x * blockDim.x)\n        row[c] = 0.0;\n}\n\nstatic void gemm_nt(bool lower, int M, int N, int K, const double* A, size_t lda, const double* B,\n                    size_t ldb, double* C, size_t ldc, double alpha, double beta, int lb0, int nprocs,\n                    int rank, int colBase, cudaStream_t s) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0) return;\n    dim3 grid(N / TN, M / TM);\n    if (lower)\n        gemm_nt_kernel<true><<<grid, 256, 0, s>>>(K, A, lda, B, ldb, C, ldc, alpha, beta, lb0, nprocs,\n                                                  rank, colBase);\n    else\n        gemm_nt_kernel<false><<<grid, 256, 0, s>>>(K, A, lda, B, ldb, C, ldc, alpha, beta, lb0, nprocs,\n                                                   rank, colBase);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed matrix layout helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Dist {\n    size_t n = 0;    // matrix size\n    int nblk = 0;    // number of block rows (padded)\n    size_t np = 0;   // padded size = nblk * NB (also leading dimension)\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    int nloc = 0;    // local block rows on this rank\n\n    int nlocOf(int r) const { return nblk > r ? (nblk - r + nprocs - 1) / nprocs : 0; }\n    // First local block index of rank r whose global block index >= g\n    int firstOf(int r, int g) const {\n        const int f = g <= r ? 0 : (g - r + nprocs - 1) / nprocs;\n        return std::min(f, nlocOf(r));\n    }\n    int first(int g) const { return firstOf(rank, g); }\n    long globalRow(int lb, int r) const { return (long)(lb * nprocs + rank) * NB + r; }\n};\n\n// C[i][j] = sum_{k} X[ri*ldx + k] * X[j*ldx + k] for j <= ri (ri = rows[i]), k ascending.\n// Results written to out[i*ldo + j]. If triK, X[j][k] == 0 for k > j is exploited.\n// Summation order per element matches the straightforward sequential dot product.\nstatic void syrkLowerRows(const double* X, size_t ldx, size_t klen, const std::vector<long>& rows,\n                          double* out, size_t ldo, bool triK) {\n    constexpr size_t BI = 32, BJ = 64, BK = 256;\n    const size_t nr = rows.size();\n    if (nr == 0) return;\n    const size_t nti = (nr + BI - 1) / BI;\n    // Pairs (i-tile, j-tile) with j-tile start <= max row in i-tile\n    std::vector<std::pair<size_t, size_t>> tasks;\n    for (size_t ti = 0; ti < nti; ++ti) {\n        long maxRow = 0;\n        for (size_t i = ti * BI; i < std::min(nr, (ti + 1) * BI); ++i) maxRow = std::max(maxRow, rows[i]);\n        for (size_t ja = 0; ja <= (size_t)maxRow; ja += BJ) tasks.push_back({ti, ja});\n    }\n#pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        std::vector<double> acc(BI * BJ);\n#pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < tasks.size(); \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfkJvwadv4MJ2PZM6TBjn","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01UcyuDL16X7rQ1oukoMKiVV","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /tmp && cat > agtest.cpp <<'EOF'\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <vector>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\nint main(int c,char**v){MPI_Init(&c,&v);int r,p;MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD,&r);MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD,&p);\nsize_t per=4*1024*1024/8; double*s,*rv; cudaMallocHost(&s,per*8); cudaMallocHost(&rv,per*8*p);\nstd::vector<int> cn(p,per),ds(p);for(int i=0;i<p;i++)ds[i]=i*per;\nfor(int it=0;it<3;it++)MPI_Allgatherv(s,per,MPI_DOUBLE,rv,cn.data(),ds.data(),MPI_DOUBLE,MPI_COMM_WORLD);\ndouble t=MPI_Wtime();for(int it=0;it<20;it++)MPI_Allgatherv(s,per,MPI_DOUBLE,rv,cn.data(),ds.data(),MPI_DOUBLE,MPI_COMM_WORLD);t=(MPI_Wtime()-t)/20;\nif(!r)printf(\"allgather %zu MB recv per rank: %.3f ms -> %.2f GB/s\\n\",per*8*p>>20,t*1e3,per*8.0*p/t/1e9);MPI_Finalize();}\nEOF\nmpicxx -O2 agtest.cpp -o agtest -I/usr/include -lcudart 2>&1 | tail -3; mpirun -np 4 --bind-to none ./agtest; mpirun -np 4 --bind-to none --mca btl self,vader ./agtest; ompi_info | grep -i \"btl\\|smsc\" | head"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2032,"cache_read_input_tokens":65290,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2032},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bdde48c0-6618-4204-880d-329ee0605ee0","uuid":"164c2dfb-5e61-4c9d-886d-86d99978b465","timestamp":"2026-10-06T03:56:33.870Z","request_id":"req_011CfkJvwLFghwrai7Z63DCo"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfkLgYXAQ7DqchkDhxrYQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I rewrote `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` as an MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program, with the executable still named `cholesky`. It validates for every size and rank count I tried (n from 1 to 4000, 1–4 ranks). Its output matches the original sequential code to within the last digit, and is bitwise identical whether it runs on 1, 2, 3 or 4 ranks.\n\n**How the work is split**\n- **MPI:** the matrix is divided into 128-row blocks dealt round-robin to the ranks, and each rank drives one GPU on its node. At each step, the rank owning the next diagonal block factors it and broadcasts the result. Each rank then solves its share of that block column, and all ranks exchange the pieces so every GPU can update its own rows.\n- **CUDA:** I wrote my own FP64 matrix-multiply kernels instead of using cuBLAS, to avoid any new library dependency. Two GPU streams let the next step's factorization and communication run while the big update is still in progress. Giving the critical-path stream high priority alone cut 4-GPU time by about 25%.\n- **CPU and OpenMP:** the small 128×128 diagonal-block factorization runs on the CPU. On the RTX 3090 that is about 3× faster than doing it on one GPU core, because these cards are weak at double precision. OpenMP parallelises matrix generation and validation, which produce exactly the same input values and validation results as the original.\n\n**Performance (4× RTX 3090)**\n\n| n | 1 GPU | 2 GPUs | 4 GPUs |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 8192 | 356 ms | 209 ms | 183 ms (1.0 TFLOPS) |\n| 16384 | 2523 ms (581 GFLOPS, about the card's FP64 peak) | 1328 ms | 865 ms (1.7 TFLOPS) |\n| 32768* | 20.3 s (578 GFLOPS) | – | 5.6 s (2.1 TFLOPS, 3.7× over 1 GPU) |\n\n\\*Measured before the last round of optimisations.\n\nThe default n=512 now takes 2–3 ms.\n\n**Limitations**\n- **Small matrices don't scale across GPUs.** MPI on this machine only reaches about 3 GB/s between processes, so around n=4096 and below, 4 GPUs are no faster than 1 or 2. A 2D layout would only help beyond about 4 GPUs, so I didn't build it.\n- **What the timer covers:** it includes copying the matrix to and from the GPUs and all communication. It excludes buffer allocation (the original also allocates outside its timer). It also excludes collecting the full result on rank 0, which only happens when `-r` or `-v` is given.\n- **Build:** nvcc 12.0 can't use GCC 13, so `CMakeLists.txt` uses `g++-12` when it's installed. It builds for the local GPU type, and the diagonal kernel design needs a GPU of compute capability 8.0 or newer.\n\n**Running it:** start one rank per GPU, e.g. `mpirun -np 4 --bind-to none ./cholesky -n 16384`. Use `--bind-to none` or set `OMP_NUM_THREADS`, because Open MPI's default core binding would leave each rank's OpenMP with a single core.\n\nThe build directory and the test copies of the original code are only in `/tmp`; nothing was added to the repo."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":860,"cache_read_input_tokens":139528,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":860},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bdde48c0-6618-4204-880d-329ee0605ee0","uuid":"0bc4cb40-6885-49fb-8b2a-3e2426568e1c","timestamp":"2026-10-06T04:19:17.311Z","request_id":"req_011CfkLgXyQpU6RkML2nxfCh"}
